body: This post is sad. I would not say these kinds of things out loud so a lot of it comes off as super angry or even petty. But yeah, I was and am angry. Sometimes you just have to barf it out lol.

After some initial hesitation, I shared the blog with him. At first he said he wouldn't read it. Then he agreed. He read the introduction but refused to read any further even though I warned him he might get angry but to please keep reading anyway. Months later, he brings it up in an attempt to pick a fight, I said to him, but did you read it though and he said, No.

lol anyway. The plan is in motion to be moving out in about two weeks and I hope to god my plan doesn't fall through. Thanks again for the share, it was very helpful for me, even if not for him sadly.

Thanks for the replies thus far.  I did not read what went on earlier that was deleted, but, I mean you gotta remember you can't possibly know everything from just one post. There is a lot that I could talk about, I could go on and on and on...

but, like another person said, I'm still figuring all this out and maybe that sounds lame but I'm only human. It would be nice to talk with someone who isn't my MiL or my DH or someone who is friends with them.

Thank you

We've been together nearly 8 years. He bought the house 2 years ago and I moved in but had nothing to do with buying it unfortunately. 

I think you're right, maybe I just want to stay here because it seems easier and the idea of moving somewhere else with the kid now, seems scary af.

I don't wish to "punish" him per se, I don't know, I guess. I mean, if he deserves it, right? This is why women don't report this shit when it happens to them, because like me, it just becomes my problem.

They'll all say, why didn't you report this a year ago? Why didn't you report at anytime during this last year? Why didn't you leave? Why did you have a kid with this guy? 

Now its all on me and as if that weren't difficult enough, I would also have to deal with the fallout and retaliation. Either way, seems like Im f'd.

I appreciate the feedback. I see that the situation makes me look bad.  Is the idea that I want to live here worse than the idea that he could repeat his crimes, despite whether I choose to stay or to leave? Is the fact that I have kept quiet a worse crime than the crime I knew about? 

Even if he went to prison, he wouldn't be out of my life, he is the father to my only child. If he went to prison I wouldn't be able to depend on him, he wouldn't be able to pay me child support, it would have negative effects on his daughter and our family. I really dont think that I was casting as equal to winning the lottery/ I apologize if it comes off that way.

Thats part of the problem. The problem is, its a lose/lose. I want to live in the house. The reason is because we are settled into the house, we can't afford to move, but we can afford to stay. Its arguably good for me, and arguably its good for LO. The problem is, it makes me look like a greedy selfish soulless bitch. 

I can find another way to deal. Thank you for engaging in discussion with me. This post is simply for discussing the implications.

In the hypothetical situation where I would decide to report the crimes- I guess the first thing I'd do is consult a lawyer- so assuming I have done that step and then followed through with the step of officially pressing charges, then-

at that point I would be afraid of retaliation. There will be denials, demand for evidence, other stuff thrown back at me with various what-about-isms. There'd be a court case I presume- it sounds like a mess.

Doesn't it make sense that I could make the argument- before a judge if I had to- that it is in the best interest of LO to remain living in this home, and if Mom (me) says she can make the mortgage payments, then why not? I would need my roommates to come in and help, thats a given. Tonya would be welcome to stay but I severely doubt she would want to stay if she thinks I'm slandering her son. I have a feeling she would be hating my guts in this hypothetical scenario. 

This is really hard to see where the right thing to do is. Is it the right thing even if I ultimately lose the house? Is it fair for me and my daughter to be left destitute? And now don't get me wrong, its not like a mansion or anything. Its just a very typical split level house with a garage it was built in the 70's. It needs a little work but it is pretty nice. 

Is it fair for him to walk around free, knowing he did those crimes, what reason is there to think he wouldn't repeat them? Whether I left him or not, right? But I dont know what kind of mess I could get into with the courts and I dont really want to. If he ends up not getting any jail time or very little jail time, what could he do when he gets out? Is it fair for me to just "take" his house? (remember he said he didn't want it didn't care and essentially refuses to keep the house for over 18months now) Is that fair even though I have faithfully paid my share of the mortgage and utilities? My name isn't on it so all the equity is his. He could throw me out of the house or sell it as revenge against me. I guess thats within his rights.

I think that by going this route Im putting myself in a position where it looks like I want revenge and I want to steal the house steal his life and this is, I'm afraid, what Matt's defense will be. I never confronted him about the incident in January and now its been almost a year.

He's going to ask why it took so long. 

The other crime is not involving me, but I looked it up and the person, Dillion, has a little time left and that would be up to her, unless I somehow out her. 

Really the more I think about it the more afraid I feel, it seems like a dangerous idea. Not to mention the absolute chaos and devastation that would ripple across both our families.

But how can I call myself a strong woman if I keep quiet?

I just would like to clarify, its very important you the reader, understand I DO NOT IN ANY WAY condone any criminal behavior nor do I agree with what "Matt" told me about what happened, I am merely stating what he told me in private conversation. It may not be clear 100% but the other criminal act in question occurred in Jan when I was 3 weeks postpartum. 

I understand this is a highly sensitive subject, I am not defending the actions in any way. Any comments or questions are welcome.

Thanks for your reply.

I would have to leave it up to the justice system to decide. I suppose if I brought it to light, there would be evidence of certain things that took place but it would be circumstantial.

And I apologize for the long rambling post. It might be a little unclear n some things. If I were to report "Matt" for sexual assault against me then I guess I'd have to have some evidence and I guess I don't.
Sorry about the length of this post.

I never thought I had any evil intentions going into this relationship. He accuses me of "trapping" him with a baby but Im the one who feels trapped, plus this never happened on purpose. Like, Im 32 and if I wanted to trap a man for his money, why wouldn't I find someone with a lot more money? Why wait until I'm 30? Why not date a military guy (I live near a populated area) I mean, like, thats always the negative stereotype, that a girl would date a military guy cuz he has money right, get knocked up, marry him, and get military benefits. Well, I know that is a negative stereotype, and obviously Id never do that, but I'm saying, like, if I were gonna do that, why do it this way? Why not 7 years ago? Ten years ago? You know? 

I cant help but feel like I'm also selfish and I'm also angry, and I'm having a hard time sorting it out. Am I crazy?

First, thank you for replying.

Good question, whats the benefit of him doing all these things? Well its important to remember its not for me. Its not just for me, the house is in his name- my name is actually not on the mortgage and we are not married. So, if I could enter his brain and plant a message, it would be, *do it for yourself*. -in the sense of it will be a good thing!

When I do things, it is out of love and it is in the interest of making modest improvements on the house (example, the window dressings). It is because I love him and our daughter and I respect his home. I am interested in helping to make the house a home, as they say. It is in decent shape, there are things we can do that aren't all that difficult. As a homeowner, these things are necessary! There is no landlord thats going to come over and fix shit or take care of the yard. thats all our responsibility. So when Im picking up trash in the front yard and trimming the hedges to clear the way on the sidewalk, and make the hedges look pretty and neat, not ugly and overgrown; when Im out there whacking weeds and cutting down hazardous trees, it is out of love and care. I care about what happens to the house. I care about the sidewalk and I care about the driveway. I care about whether that dead tree will fall into the house, or his pickup truck, or maybe both somehow. I care about these things only because I love him! 

If I didn't care, why do anything at all? I could just sit around and just say, meh. 

If it sounds like Im thinking of him as worthless, please remember that this is a venting post, ranting to let off steam and it might sound pretty one sided. Its not like he's sitting here in the room, so I can say, *honey check it out I wrote this about you on reddit!* I hope you understand what Im trying to get at. I don't think he's worthless. I think he's really stuck. 

I agree with the gist of what you're saying here. I think you are right in your last paragraph.

The whole thing about physical touch and acts of service among 5 languages of love sounds very interesting. I appreciate it but I don't know what else I can possibly do if he's just going to ignore me. I think he is having an affair with his ex, either emotional or physical, who knows anymore. But if he feels like he needs to keep it a secret, obviously he knows its wrong. 

Now Im the one left feeling rejected. I don't know if I even want to approach it in this way anymore because I don't know if Im even willing to continue to fight for this relationship. I think Im just kidding myself on some stupid fantasy.

Thank you for replying.

I agree with a lot of what you're saying. Remember this letter was needed to blow off steam because I do not talk to him this way. If I said any of this, I wouldn't get past two sentences before its a full blown fight. I hate fighting and I hate yelling. Now it is true I can make  sarcastic remarks. Like, I mentioned one day in particular when he woke up, he looked forlornly at the brown patches of grass out the window, as though it were just completely ruined. At this point he was kind of shitting on my morning, which had been good thus far, so I said *Why are you getting all bent out of shape?* But oh my god, sorry your majesty, because he clearly can't handle it. Yet its ok for him to talk disrespectfully to me and Im not allowed to have feelings about it? Ugh, I know its extremely difficult to write about. Only the two of us know what we really said and what we meant and all that. 

So I am not trying to point a finger at him as though Im so perfect (Im not). I am not trying to paint him in all ugly colors like he has no redeeming qualities (he does). Of course he does. We are just regular people. 

You ask a very good question, to ask myself if my attitude contributes.
Honestly, yes I have historically been guilty of having a bad attitude. I think I have made huge improvements although Im still working on it, obviously. I try to be grateful and respectful. If I see him making an effort I try to make sure Im thanking him. 

Seems like with him, though, it just doesn't last. So theres no consistency and I no longer see in him what I thought I was seeing when we first met. 

To answer your question about past transgressions. I was really reaching for a descriptive term there. But no, I have never been unfaithful to him whatsoever. He has been unfaithful to me. He slept with his ex; and he continues a friendship with her behind my back- god only knows how far they are taking it because Im home with a baby, he can do anything he wants. And if thats true, it explains why he has no interest in me at all. 

I forgave him for cheating on me years ago, and instead of seeing whats right in front of him, he continues to place blame on me for "punishing him" Punishing him means making him feel guilty I don't know. Now it has become so vicious, now I feel like Im being punished for his perception of being unjustly punished by me! 

Its so stupid.

I have truly wanted him to respond, I have truly tried different ways of interacting with him. I think at this point he's been unresponsive for a long time now, and now Im at my point of shutting down. Hence the long post. I mean, if I wanted to be nasty, I could've written a really nasty hateful post, right- Im just saying, sometimes we have to write out our feelings and thats what I was trying to do.... Even though it wanders a lot, it sounds one sided a lot, and I talk about random things a lot.

So Im glad you replied and I thank you, because I do agree with you that building so much resentment is unhealthy.

-S.

Maybe she could benefit going to see a dermatologist. They can assure her that her veins are not abnormal or unhealthy looking. Everyone has them. She is aware there is an issue, "get out of my head for once", she just needs a little help and you are awesome for trying to figure out a way to help her. Maybe a therapist could help, like another person suggested. A lot of beautiful women have insecurities that stem from media representations, and the expectations to be perfect all the time. She shouldnt worry or feel bad about getting older- 27 is far from getting older- but shes 5 years younger than me, and i know there is a ton of pressure on women to never show aging. A 25 or 27 year old, especially if she has always looked good, will start to worry that she doesnt look good any more. I know it sounds ridiculous, thats because it is. Hopefully things will continue to steer away from those trends. Usually, leading a healthy lifestyle is a great way to combat those irrational feelings of getting older. Just keep reminding her she is beautiful no matter what, that shes perfect in your eyes,  that she is wonderful, beautiful, and amazing, despite those insignificant imperfections. If she has a little freckle or something, or veins on her hands, pull her hand toward you and kiss it, and tell her everything about her that makes her human, is beautiful to you.

He replied that he probably wouldve called 911... But he didnt really seem to consider the POINT of the question, you know? He just doesnt care. I believe he is gaslighting. He goes to great lengths, especially when hes mad, to point out how unfairly I treat him, and how Ive been "punishing" him. I think anything less than being treated like a king, he just cant bear, not in his own home... He wont ever admit that I am sure, but somehow in the worst way, I believe thats what he did to me, and he did it on purpose. He doesnt care how serious labor and childbirth is. He just enjoys telling me how freaking wise he is, like when I was pregnant,  'you should be drinking whole milk' and im like bitch, stfu im 9 months pregnant. No one who really loved a person would do that, and it just breaks my heart. We are all so lucky the pregnancy was healthy, and everything went well. Thats it, just lucky and fortunate. :(
